Existing scoped writer preserves trash/current membership and the durable deferred physical deletion queue. This action never physically deletes files or cancels physical queue records. Clearing actual import-status deletion records permits ordinary reimport.

Each batch of up to64 independently commits; the first failing batch aborts subsequent writes without rolling back prior successful batches. The native owner presents Store errors as warnings; reference asynchronous content transport is made synchronous only in copied fixture proof.

Native retained hidden, retired/rebound or different-page callbacks are refused. Actual current-page departure permanently invalidates a menu/answer even after returning; an owned advanced deletion child blocks dispatch/accept. These native ownership boundaries are additional to ordinary Qt modal input blocking, not invented recapture of file eligibility.

Future duplicate copies can only reuse cache-owned full rasters, while the current presentation remains independently retained.
